habitai_unified_platform.title: HABITAI · Unified Operations Platform
habitai_unified_platform.problem: Operations data lived in ERP, CRM, logistics, and spreadsheets with no single place for owners or field teams to act.
habitai_unified_platform.built: Operations cockpit tying PHC data, CRM sync, automation, inventory signals, and agent-assisted Q&A on governed metrics.
impact: 80+ production workflows (~22.5k n8n runs in a recent 7-day sample)
MCP read-only ERP Q&A with per-call audit logging
Single nervous system for warehouses, distributors, finance, and field ops

phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.title: PHC ERP · Cloud Read Replica
phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.problem: CRM and automations could not safely use live ERP data without exposing on-prem SQL or copying numbers by hand.
phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.built: Hybrid sync to PostgreSQL on a VPS, dbt marts, role-scoped access, and executive dashboards for two PHC tenants.
impact: 5.4M+ governed rows across HabitArmos and Estores tenants
15-minute incremental sync; ~11k Estores customers mapped to Twenty CRM
Read-only MCP metric catalog with regression-tested definitions

zohosync_habitarmos.title: ZohoSync · PHC ↔ Zoho Commercial Intelligence
zohosync_habitarmos.problem: Sales leadership relied on disconnected spreadsheets instead of live ERP-backed objectives and pipeline health.
zohosync_habitarmos.built: FastAPI/Redis incremental bridge from PHC to Zoho Bigin with rep KPIs, distributor analytics, and HABITAI consult views.
impact: 893 Bigin accounts / 2,405 contacts / ~2k pipeline records (Oct 2026)
500+ distributor network on PHC-backed gap-to-target coaching
Feeds Gestão de Comerciais and MCP ERP Q&A

blinds_field_ops_pwa.title: app-tecnicos · Field Operations PWA
blinds_field_ops_pwa.problem: Field service ran on paper: slow customer updates, lost technician time, and no shared schedule when clients called.
blinds_field_ops_pwa.built: Production PWA with offline queue, maps and routing, warehouse module, and Twenty CRM sync on Hetzner.
impact: ~40 technicians use the app daily in production
Offline-first queue for visits, photos, and status updates
Twenty CRM sync replaces manual dispatch spreadsheets

orcamentos_ia_platform.title: orcamentos-ia · Multi-Supplier Quoting
orcamentos_ia_platform.problem: Quotes depended on manual PDF and spreadsheet work; sales waited days while prices had to stay auditable.
orcamentos_ia_platform.built: FastAPI and React platform with supplier plug-ins, deterministic pricing tiers, PDF ingestion, and CRM handoff.
impact: 124k+ deterministic price tiers in the catalog
Supplier plug-ins and PDF ingestion cut quote turnaround
Auditable pricing path from supplier data to CRM

alygen_crm_b2b.title: Alygen CRM · B2B Outreach Stack
alygen_crm_b2b.problem: Freelance prospecting meant hours of manual site audits and slow, generic proposals per lead.
alygen_crm_b2b.built: Open-source CRM with automated technical audits, ML lead scoring, agent-assisted copy, and email and messaging dispatch.
impact: 6,000+ B2B companies audited with automated technical scoring
Agent-assisted proposals and outreach from structured lead data
Open-source stack for portfolio and live client work

container_risk_radar_habitarmos.title: Container Risk Radar · Fleet Observability
container_risk_radar_habitarmos.problem: Websites, VPS hosts, containers, and automations were monitored in separate tools with no shared risk picture.
container_risk_radar_habitarmos.built: Docker Compose observability stack with Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, scoring engine, and a Next.js control dashboard.
impact: Unified risk score across n8n, VPS, cPanel, and container workloads
Telegram/Slack alerting when sync or infra signals degrade
Next.js dashboard with live SSE updates for triage

lfg_discord_bot.title: LFG Valorant · Discord Community Platform
lfg_discord_bot.problem: A ~13k-member Valorant guild relied on manual chat codes; matchmaking did not scale and moderators lacked structure.
lfg_discord_bot.built: Open-source bot + FastAPI API + React OAuth PWA with Postgres lobbies, gamification, and guild analytics on Hetzner.
impact: 4,186 LFG requests and 4,186 weekly active users in 7 days (Oct 2026)
~1k messages/day and ~+35% activity in the first weekend after NPVP migration
380k+ lifetime structured LFG requests tracked (legacy + bot)
